nodes.label: L.spin — the detachable leaf (keyed member form)
nodes.rationale: Grade PROVED, source M §11.6 with Euler 1748 and Lauritzen 1996, depends on L.tree, L.rankpoly, L.chi, depth 5. The leaf is read off the caterpillar of L.tree.

nodes.label: 2S is a detachable leaf of the constraint tree
nodes.rationale: 2S appears in exactly one bound, 2S <= k, so its sum over the cells closes as a geometric series (1 - z^{k+1})/(1 - z) and multiplies the rank polynomial by that factor and nothing else.

nodes.label: The 319-cell seven-coordinate projection
nodes.rationale: Removing 2S projects Lambda onto (n, l, k, q, e, f, g) with 319 cells, itself closed with polytope integer points equal to its cells, so E = 0 before and after; each seven-cell carries exactly k+1 spin values and Sum(k+1) = 976 recovers the full count.
